[SKU-V15 / VENDOR / NETSUITE WMS]

NetSuite WMS cost

NetSuite WMS is an add-on module on top of NetSuite ERP, not a standalone platform. Priced per-user plus a module fee, quote-only. SuiteSuccess for Wholesale Distribution and SuiteSuccess for Retail both bundle WMS into the SKU.

[SKU-A / PRICING POSTURE]

Quote-only

Add-on module on top of NetSuite ERP; per-user plus module fee, quote only[s-16].

[SKU-B / COST DRIVERS]

What changes the quote

  • Underlying NetSuite ERP licence (the WMS sits on top).
  • Named users with WMS access.
  • SuiteSuccess bundle vs standalone WMS module.
  • Implementation hours (the SI is usually a NetSuite ACS or partner).
[SKU-C / RECENT CHANGES]

2025-26 product and pricing

NetSuite WMS remains an add-on module rather than a separate platform. SuiteSuccess for Wholesale Distribution and SuiteSuccess for Retail both include WMS in the bundle.

[SKU-D / FIT]

When this vendor is the answer

  • Existing NetSuite customer wanting RF directed picking and wave picking inside the ERP.
  • Mid-market wholesale distribution on SuiteSuccess.
  • Retail running NetSuite SuiteSuccess for Retail with single or few-DC fulfilment.
[SKU-E / FAQ]

Buyer questions

What does NetSuite WMS cover that core NetSuite Inventory does not?

RF directed picking, putaway logic, wave picking, mobile receiving, license-plate tracking. Core NetSuite Inventory is bin-level and form-based.

When does NetSuite WMS fall short?

Goods-to-person robotics orchestration, advanced slotting, voice-pick, complex multi-client 3PL billing. For these, bolt on a best-of-breed (Korber, Softeon) or move off NetSuite.
